purpose: Frozen fixed-operator and evaluation contract for accumulation-after-SIC sensing CIR evaluation. Everything here is frozen on the calibration seed set BEFORE the acceptance seed set is run. Changing a value after acceptance has been touched requires a new run directory and an explicit note in the development report.

operator.name: code9_sampled_code_average
operator.origin_source: work_fullwin_geometry(pre_us=2.0).pre_guard; public local plan, never the injected comm start
operator.correlation: H[r,t] = sum_m y[origin + r*sps + t + m] * conj(code[m]) / code_energy
operator.correlation_direction: matched filter with the conjugated bare code (identical to MATLAB estimateCir / the C++ radar CIR estimate_radar_cir)
operator.template: code-9 sampled_code recovered from the public modulator (127 ternary chips -> spread x4 -> 2 samples/pulse); NOT the shaped waveform
operator.normalization: fixed 1/code_energy (code_energy = 64); no per-window L2 / peak / per-branch normalization
operator.phase_rotation: identity (the same for all three branches); no per-symbol or per-branch derotation
operator.convention: average: H_N = (1/N) sum_r H[r]; sum counterpart is H_sum = N * H_avg
operator.linearity: H_x is a linear functional of y_x; the three branches share origin, template, tap grid, gain and symbol set
operator.support_note: the matched filter multiplies by conj(code[m]); only the 64 nonzero template indices are read, so the exact read support of repetition r over taps [tap_lo,tap_hi) is [origin+r*sps+tap_lo+nz_min, origin+r*sps+tap_hi-1+nz_max] (inclusive)

roi.mapping_note: weak sensing path = delay 37 work samples, gain 0.25, on top of the delay-0 unit path (public local sensing profile). The public causal pulse shape has centre tap +2, so the direct peak lands on offset 2 and the weak-target peak on offset 39; the R04 receiver ROI [51,60) / tap 55 is exactly this ROI / peak shifted by cir_pre=16 (receiver_tap = fixed_offset + 16). The ROI is re-verified on calibration-only seeds at run start and never re-searched on SIC results.

repetition_sets.indep_n_shortening: the reported N list is a prefix of indep_nominal_N plus the actual available count when it is shorter than 56; no padding, no silent relabelling
repetition_sets.legacy_indep_note: the old [8,8+N) label reads training/guard samples (r=8 reads from 10093 < visible_end) and, at the far end, un-subtracted tail samples (r=63 reads up to 67140 > sub_hi-1). It is kept ONLY as legacy_nominal_index_diagnostic and never used as the main result.
repetition_sets.shared_sample_set_note: the main table uses one common safe set covering the full tap grid for all ROIs; per-ROI support sets are an appendix because they use different sample sets

sic.frozen: the S1 shared core/adapter is NOT modified by S2-A

metric_definitions.g_accum_db: 10log10(P(1)/P(N)) on the nested same-start set; this is an ACCUMULATION gain, never an SIC gain
metric_definitions.eta: ||sum_r E_r||^2 / (N sum_r ||E_r||^2) on one window; 1 = coherent, ~1/N = i.i.d. zero mean; N/A on zero energy

evaluation.zero_handling: exact zeros are reported as +Inf / -Inf / N/A; no eps floor and no arbitrary dB clipping. *_clipped fields exist only for figures with plot_floor_db=-80 and plot_ceil_db=140.

seeds.rule: seed = base + cell_index*stride + window_index; calibration and acceptance windows are disjoint by construction and re-checked at runtime and in the verifier

substreams.noise: np.random.default_rng(seed) - the only RNG in SicSignalGenerator.build

archive_policy.rule: the first 8 windows of every cell, selected by window index only (no metric-based selection); the remaining windows cannot be recomputed from the archive

coherence.centered_note: e_centered is deterministic-structure energy, not proven random noise: a phase ramp lands there too
coherence.retired: schema 1 mean_fraction = ||mu||^2/e_total mixed a per-symbol-average energy with the N-symbol total; it is now null with a supersession note and coherent_fraction is authoritative
